text: A journey is a long trip from one place to another. Mr. Bushby's journey was a walk that took 28 years.
A strict rule is one you must follow every time. Mr. Bushby made strict rules for himself.
A generous person gives to others and helps them. Strangers gave him food and a place to sleep.
A strait is a narrow strip of water between two lands.
The Bering Strait is a narrow strip of sea between Alaska and Russia. In winter, ice can float in it.
Hull is a city in England. It is Mr. Bushby's hometown.
England is a country in Europe. It is part of the United Kingdom.
South America is a huge land with many countries. It is far south of the United States.
Punta Arenas is a city at the very bottom of South America.
Chile is a long, thin country in South America.
Alaska is a big, cold state in the far north of the United States.
Russia is the largest country in the world. It is across the Bering Strait from Alaska.
Iran is a country in Asia.
The Caspian Sea is a very large lake. It is so big that people call it a sea.
Istanbul is a big city in Turkey.
Turkey is a country in Asia and Europe. It is not the bird.
A kilometer is a way to measure distance. It is a little more than half a mile.
A country is a land with its own borders and leaders. The United States is one country.
A challenge is something hard that you try to do.
To complete something means to finish it.
A bet is when you say you can do something hard. Someone says you cannot.
A soldier is a person who works in the army.
Vehicles are machines that carry people, like cars, buses, and planes.
On foot means by walking. You do not ride in anything.
Survival means staying alive when things are hard.
A tent is a small shelter made of cloth. People sleep in it outside.
A stranger is a person you do not know.
Extreme means very big or very hard.
A jungle is a thick, hot forest with many plants and animals.
A desert is a very dry place with little rain.
Here, fighting means a war. It is a place that is not safe.
Floating ice is ice that sits on top of the water.
Jail is a place where people are kept when they break a rule or law.
A cart is a small thing with wheels. You push or pull it to carry things.
A miracle is a wonderful surprise that seems almost too good to be true.
A donation is a gift of money or things to help someone.
A company is a business that makes or sells things.
Kinder means more kind. Kind people are gentle and helpful.
A crowd is a big group of people together.
Nervous means a little worried about what will happen.
A mission is an important job or goal.
